psychological_meaning: Coffee Bean evokes feelings of warmth, comfort, and reliability. It is often associated with nature, earthiness, and stability. This color can also represent simplicity, practicality, and a sense of grounding. It is a comforting and reassuring color, suggesting dependability and resourcefulness.
